dee_customer_admin: Hi team — billing on our account is blocked. Procurement says they won't accept an invoice until we provide an official PO number in their format and they need the approver's email on the PO. Can you confirm what you need from us?

sara_support: Sorry for the trouble, Dee. We show an invoice draft (ID: INV-87321) stuck at 'awaiting PO'. invoices_bot just flagged it. Can you share the PO when it's ready or the purchasing contact so we can coordinate? :pray:

invoices_bot: Automated notice: Invoice INV-87321 generation paused — required field missing: `purchase_order_id`. Submit PO to resume issuance. (Link to draft: https://invoices.redwood.ai/drafts/INV-87321)

dee_customer_admin: Procurement said the PO must include: 1) Official PO number (no free-text), 2) Approver email, 3) Cost center / GL code, 4) VAT country code (for EU). They also want a template/field mapping we can hand to their SAP team. Can you provide a sample?

raj_billing: Yep — we need a valid PO string (alphanumeric) in the `PO Number` field and the approver's email in the `Authorized By` line. For EU VAT we also need `VAT ID` in the billing block. If any of those are missing the invoice export will fail our AP ingestion.

sara_support: Sharing a tiny sample you can paste into procurement (feel free to forward):

```
Vendor: Redwood Inference Ltd.
PO Number: 2026-RI-00987
Authorized By: john.smith@custco.com
Cost Center / GL: 4500-ML-ENG
VAT ID: GB999999973
Notes: Redwood invoice draft INV-87321
```

sara_support: If procurement uses Coupa/Ariba, please send the coupa ID or a PDF of the PO. We can accept EDI or PDF, but their fields must map to the ones above.

dee_customer_admin: Is there anything you can do on your side to issue a proforma or temp invoice so we can unblock internal payments while procurement finishes the PO?

raj_billing: We can issue a proforma, but procurement told us explicitly they will not process proformas for payment. If you'd like a proforma for internal visibility we can create one (PRO-87321) — it won't trigger collection or update the draft invoice status.

taylor_ae: Looping in @emily_finance_ops to help with the approver mapping and to confirm whether any account-level exceptions apply. We might be able to accept an approver email uploaded separately if procurement allows a manual match.

emily_finance_ops: Hi all — quick note: for enterprise customers we can set a temporary acceptance rule, but it requires legal sign-off and an audit trail. That typically takes 48–72h. If procurement can provide a signed PO PDF with the approver email we can fast-track to same-day issuance.

procurement_bot: Internal note: Customer's procurement policy flagged — requires `Approver Email`, `Cost Center`, and `Official PO ID format` (prefix '2026-'). No further action until PO received.

dee_customer_admin: Thanks — I'll feed the sample to procurement and ask for a PDF with the approver email. One last Q — will the invoice include VAT breakdown automatically or do you need a separate VAT certificate?

raj_billing: If you provide `VAT ID` and country in the PO, our billing system will include the VAT lines automatically. If procurement needs a VAT certificate, attach it to the PO submission or send to billing@redwood.ai and reference INV-87321.

sara_support: Next steps / owners:
- Dee: send PO PDF or Coupa/Ariba ID + approver email (owner: customer)
- Raj: once PO received, validate fields and issue final invoice (owner: raj_billing)
- Emily: evaluate temporary exception if PO can't be produced in 72h (owner: emily_finance_ops)

dee_customer_admin: Got it — I'll push this through procurement and update here with a PDF or Coupa ID. Thanks for the quick turnaround. :+1:

sara_support: Thanks — marking ticket INC-2026-5491 as blocked by `awaiting_po`. We'll update when invoice issues.

invoices_bot: Ticket update: INC-2026-5491 — status "blocked" (reason: PO required). Notification sent to billing queue.

raj_billing: FYI — when you post the PO, please include the exact string in `PO Number` so our AP ingestion doesn't create a duplicate (we match on that exact value). If you have any trouble scanning the PDF, we can accept a screenshot of the header as long as the PO number and approver email are readable.

dee_customer_admin: Uploading PO PDF now — coupa ID: COU-554433. I'll paste the PDF link here once procurement confirms.
